keySentence: Tom did not want to paint the fence that morning.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Tom painted very slowly. The sun was hot. He wanted to play. Tom did not want to paint the fence that morning.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Tom dipped his brush and painted one slow stroke on the fence. The hot morning sun beat down on him as he worked alone. Sweat dripped from his face and he kept looking at the river. Tom did not want to paint the fence that morning at all. Every other boy in town was free to play and have fun. But then a brilliant idea suddenly popped into Tom's head.
facts.Word cards: that morning = 그날 아침 / fence = 울타리 / brilliant idea = 좋은 생각 / clever = 영리한
